The Two-Pass Shadow Casting method by Kajiya and Von Herzen provided a foundational approach for computing shadows in participating media by separating illumination and gathering passes.
Later developments, such as Light Propagation Volumes by Kaplanyan, extended these concepts to real-time indirect illumination.
